item.text: {"decision":"Adopt the assessor proposal with evidence limits preserved. The board now supports only: the reported fall event from D01, limited initial recovered-condition observations from D01, and WP-031 task-text content from D04. The proposed physical mechanism remains unresolved because the joint incident conditions—event-time hydraulic/support-fluid loss with sufficient relative yoke withdrawal, keeper-bypass lateral/dynamic path, and actual absence of positive mechanical restraint—are not established by the searched collection. Motion, hydraulic, and execution/isolation records remain awaiting user/source production; inspection evidence remains partial.","operations":[{"action":"create","expected_version":0,"replaces":null,"reason":"Adopting assessor proposal. D01.S02 reports only two initial post-event condition observations: the keeper plate was found bolted to the recovered assembly and the beam/yoke were not reported fractured. D01.S02 expressly limits these to initial observations and not a release-mechanism conclusion. R_R3InspectionPhotos remains partial: no photographs, fastener torque/count, loosening, deformation measurements, crack-test scope, seating/contact measurements, lateral-offset marks, or preservation history were produced. This supports only the limited occurrence of the reported observations; reopening condition is production of retained inspection photos, NDE/dimensional inspection records, or preservation notes showing more detailed or contrary component condition.","record":{"id":"N_R3LimitedRecoveredCondition","kind":"node","scope_key":"r3_limited_recovered_condition_initial_observations_2024-10-14","claim":"Initial post-event observations reported the R3 keeper plate bolted to the recovered assembly and did not report beam or yoke fracture, but did not establish the release mechanism or detailed component condition.","status":"supported","sources":["D01"],"depends_on":["R_R3InspectionPhotos"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}},{"action":"create","expected_version":0,"replaces":null,"reason":"Adopting assessor proposal. D04.S01 states WP-031 covers stripper-box changeout with the balance assembly raised after backup-roll removal, calls for electrical supply isolation and hydraulic valve closure, and contains no instruction to install a positive yoke block or verify the off-center carrier retention envelope. D04.S03 limits this to procedure content and says execution records are needed to establish what workers actually did and why the omission existed. This supports procedural-content occurrence only, not actual compliance, authorization, or causal contribution.","record":{"id":"N_WP031NoBlockRetentionInstruction","kind":"node","scope_key":"wp031_text_no_positive_yoke_block_or_retention_envelope_verification","claim":"WP-031 task text called for electrical isolation and hydraulic valve closure but contained no instruction to install a positive yoke block or verify the off-center carrier retention envelope.","status":"supported","sources":["D04"],"depends_on":["R_R3ExecutionIsolation"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}},{"action":"create","expected_version":0,"replaces":null,"reason":"Adopting assessor proposal. D02.S02-S05 describes an applicable possible mechanism: loss of C17 support-chamber fluid permits downward yoke travel; relative vertical withdrawal equals yoke downward travel minus carrier downward travel; at least 30 mm relative downward yoke withdrawal eliminates primary seating engagement; keeper bypass also requires lateral-offset/dynamic-path evidence. But R_R3HydraulicRecords and R_R3MotionRecord remain awaiting_user because the searched collection lacks event-time pressure/position data, V17 leakage/return-path measurements, and yoke/carrier time-position traces. D15.S01-S02 is only an unreviewed interpretation and contains no leak measurement or retention-envelope calculation. Event-time hydraulic loss and sufficient relative withdrawal are unresolved, not refuted.","record":{"id":"N_R3HydraulicWithdrawalUnresolved","kind":"node","scope_key":"r3_event_hydraulic_loss_and_relative_withdrawal_sufficiency","claim":"During the R3 event, C17/V17 hydraulic support-fluid loss produced yoke/carrier relative vertical withdrawal sufficient to eliminate the 30 mm primary seating engagement.","status":"unresolved","sources":["D01","D02","D15"],"depends_on":["R_R3HydraulicRecords","R_R3MotionRecord"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}},{"action":"create","expected_version":0,"replaces":null,"reason":"Adopting assessor proposal. D02.S05 states that loss of primary seating engagement does not prove keeper bypass; keeper engagement depends on lateral offset and dynamic path, requiring separate evidence. R_R3InspectionPhotos remains partial because no seating/contact measurements, lateral-offset indicators, dynamic path marks, or retained photographs were produced. D15.S01 suggests excess clearance only as an unreviewed interpretation and D15.S02 says it has no retention-envelope calculation or independent witness account. Keeper bypass/dynamic path is therefore unresolved rather than supported or refuted.","record":{"id":"N_R3KeeperBypassUnresolved","kind":"node","scope_key":"r3_keeper_bypass_lateral_offset_dynamic_path_event","claim":"During the R3 event, the carrier beam followed a lateral offset and dynamic path that bypassed keeper retention after any loss of primary seating engagement.","status":"unresolved","sources":["D02","D15"],"depends_on":["R_R3InspectionPhotos","R_R3MotionRecord"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}},{"action":"create","expected_version":0,"replaces":null,"reason":"Adopting assessor proposal. D02.S06 distinguishes positive mechanical restraint from electrical isolation and hydraulic handle position. D04.S01 shows the task text did not instruct a positive yoke block, but D04.S03 says that omission is distinct from proof of what workers actually did. R_R3ExecutionIsolation remains awaiting_user because completed WP-031 steps, signoffs, and actual block presence/absence were not found. Thus actual absence of positive mechanical restraint at 13:24 is unresolved.","record":{"id":"N_R3ActualBlockAbsentUnresolved","kind":"node","scope_key":"r3_actual_positive_yoke_block_absence_event_window","claim":"At the R3 event, no positive yoke block or equivalent positive mechanical restraint was actually present to restrain the raised assembly.","status":"unresolved","sources":["D02","D04"],"depends_on":["R_R3ExecutionIsolation"],"from_ids":[],"to_id":null,"mode":null,"asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}},{"action":"create","expected_version":0,"replaces":null,"reason":"Adopting assessor proposal. The proposed physical release path requires joint conditions: event-time hydraulic/support loss with enough yoke/carrier relative withdrawal to remove 30 mm primary seating engagement, a lateral-offset/dynamic path that bypassed keeper retention, and no effective positive mechanical restraint. D02.S02-S06 describes these as distinct conditions. Current evidence does not establish those incident conditions: R_R3HydraulicRecords and R_R3MotionRecord are awaiting_user, R_R3InspectionPhotos is partial, and R_R3ExecutionIsolation is awaiting_user. D01 reports the fall but no cause. Therefore causal contribution of this mechanism to the fall remains unresolved.","record":{"id":"E_R3HydraulicWithdrawalKeeperBypassToFall","kind":"edge","scope_key":"r3_joint_hydraulic_withdrawal_keeper_bypass_no_block_caused_fall","claim":"Hydraulic support loss with sufficient relative yoke withdrawal, keeper-bypass dynamic path, and absence of positive mechanical restraint jointly caused or allowed the R3 delivery carrier beam fall.","status":"unresolved","sources":["D01","D02","D04","D15"],"depends_on":[],"from_ids":["N_R3HydraulicWithdrawalUnresolved","N_R3KeeperBypassUnresolved","N_R3ActualBlockAbsentUnresolved"],"to_id":"N_FocalEvent_R3BeamFall","mode":"all","asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}},{"action":"create","expected_version":0,"replaces":null,"reason":"Adopting assessor proposal. D04.S01 supports only that WP-031 text omitted a positive yoke block/retention-envelope verification instruction; D04.S03 explicitly says execution records are needed to know what workers did and does not explain why the procedure omitted the step. R_R3ExecutionIsolation remains awaiting_user with completed forms, isolation logs, permits, signoffs, and authorization/reason records missing. Therefore a causal path from procedure omission to actual absence of restraint is unresolved, not supported.","record":{"id":"E_WP031OmissionToBlockAbsence","kind":"edge","scope_key":"wp031_no_block_instruction_contributed_to_actual_no_positive_block","claim":"WP-031's lack of a positive-yoke-block or retention-envelope-verification instruction contributed to the actual absence of positive mechanical restraint during the R3 event.","status":"unresolved","sources":["D04"],"depends_on":[],"from_ids":["N_WP031NoBlockRetentionInstruction"],"to_id":"N_R3ActualBlockAbsentUnresolved","mode":"all","asset":null,"window":null,"fields":[]}}],"next_work":[],"upstream_dispositions":[],"disposition":"partial"}
